This startup script reads SAS_EXECFILEPATH somewhere the migration does not rewrite, so nothing was changed. It recognises one idiom only: a %let assignment whose right side is exactly %sysget(SAS_EXECFILEPATH). A script that locates itself through &_SASPROGRAMFILE, %sysfunc(getoption(sysin)) or another source needs the same hand edit: read SASLAUNCHER_STARTUP_FILE instead.
